items.item: Retrieves the components from uat before or while editing, so it does not overwrite someone else's sandbox change
items.evidence: sf project retrieve start -m Flow:Renewal_Discount -m ApexClass:PartnerDiscountService -r ../uat-compare -o uat

items.item: Runs a --dry-run deploy first, then the real deploy, both with -o uat
items.evidence: sf project deploy start --dry-run -o uat ... then 'Real deploy... same command without --dry-run' with -o uat

items.item: Uses -m (metadata) or a manifest for exactly those components, and runs the relevant tests (for example --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests ...)
